name: youtube-mcp
description: Search YouTube, manage your channel and read your analytics from your AI assistant. Every change to your account is previewed and needs your approval first.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.title: YouTube Data API key
YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Your YouTube Data API v3 key. Enough for the public search, video, channel, comment and transcript tools.

YOUTUBE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE.title: OAuth client JSON file
YOUTUBE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE.description: Desktop OAuth client JSON downloaded from Google Cloud. Used to sign in to your channel for playlists, analytics, uploads and comment replies.

YOUTUBE_MCP_PROFILE_ID.title: Profile name
YOUTUBE_MCP_PROFILE_ID.description: A short name you choose, e.g. my-channel. Keeps local state separate per channel.

YOUTUBE_MCP_CHANNEL_ID.title: Channel ID
YOUTUBE_MCP_CHANNEL_ID.description: Your channel ID starting with UC (YouTube → Settings → Advanced settings). The signed-in Google account must own it.

YOUTUBE_MCP_STATE_DIR.title: State directory
YOUTUBE_MCP_STATE_DIR.description: Where the sign-in token, approvals and local history live. Leave empty to use ~/.youtube-mcp.
